withheld_cells.label: g37-text-k1-verified-carried-p0.10-k1
withheld_cells.reason: per-tile TP/FP/FN table refused: 22 of 518 in-frame detections were credited to a tile under the 'id' tile join, a shortfall of 496. (tile_join_detection_shortfall) Most often the cell's source_tile vocabulary is not this frame's; re-run with a geometric tile_join.
withheld_cells.ruling: PI ruling 2026-09-13: withhold and list, never abort the board
withheld_cells.interval_detail: the F1 bootstrap resamples tiles, so its input is the same per-tile table the tile-join invariant refuses; the cell has a whole-frame point estimate and no interval on this frame, and any interval it previously carried is withdrawn rather than superseded

disclosure.detail: tile confusion refused: 22 of 518 in-frame detections were booked to a tile under the 'id' tile join, a shortfall of 496. The join is not describing this frame — most often because the cell's source_tile vocabulary is not the frame's. MCC is withheld rather than reported.
disclosure.ruling: PI ruling 2026-09-13 (S153 ruling 6): the name-based 'id' tile join is the published tile-MCC convention; a cell the invariant refuses reports its whole-frame F1 in full and withholds its per-tile statistics. See reports/tile-mcc-geometric-join-2026-09-12.md.

replicate_handling: single-set cells: integer per-tile of one aggregated set; replicate-mean cells (single-pass K runs, phase3c 5 replications): pass-averaged per-tile (float)

mcc_permutation.statistic: tile-level MCC (buffer-invariant: tile truth is intersection with any reference, tile prediction is any detection assigned to the tile)
mcc_permutation.swap_mask: identical to the F1 test's (same seed, same tile order, same rng.random(n_tiles) < 0.5 stream)
mcc_permutation.reported_not_tiering: PI ruling 2026-09-13 (S153 ruling 7): the MCC family is reported BESIDE the preregistered F1 tiering and does not replace it. The board's tiering is the F1 one.
